en.flavor: A prototype longbow discovered in the Blackcliff Forge. The arrow fired from this bow glimmers like a ray of moonlight.

refinements.1: Charged Attack hits on weak points increase Movement SPD by 10% and ATK by <r>36%</r> for 10s.
refinements.2: Charged Attack hits on weak points increase Movement SPD by 10% and ATK by <r>45%</r> for 10s.
refinements.3: Charged Attack hits on weak points increase Movement SPD by 10% and ATK by <r>54%</r> for 10s.
refinements.4: Charged Attack hits on weak points increase Movement SPD by 10% and ATK by <r>63%</r> for 10s.
refinements.5: Charged Attack hits on weak points increase Movement SPD by 10% and ATK by <r>72%</r> for 10s.
